title: Critique of the Khafre pyramid SAR scan model
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Critique of the Khafre pyramid SAR scan model, about 2025 at Khafre pyramid, Giza, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they took a visual 3D model of the king's chamber and the relieving chambers and they they um they duplicated it five times inside the coffer pyramid and they said this is what they're detecting.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, criticises a 2025 claim by a team including Filippo Biondi that a type of radar imaging, called synthetic aperture radar, had revealed hidden structures inside the Khafre pyramid, the second great pyramid at Giza in Egypt. Caverns says the team took a 3D model of the known King's Chamber and the small chambers above it, copied it five times into the pyramid, and presented that as what they were detecting. In his telling, that would mean the striking images were a model rather than a direct picture.
